structure_policy_rationale: Original 图标由清晰的几何符号（音符）和具象符号（火焰）组成，符合 theme_design_analysis 中 preserve_major_structure 的判定条件。参考抖音主版的迁移案例，必须保留音符的基本S形曲线和火焰的相对位置，仅对填充方式、描边和色彩进行主题化重构，严禁改变主体轮廓或将其抽象为无关图形。
preserve: 核心音符的几何骨架（左下圆环、竖线、右上弯钩的比例与拓扑结构）
底部火焰的基本形态（向上的尖角/波浪结构）
火焰位于音符下方的空间布局及轻微遮挡关系
must_preserve: 标志性的八分音符几何拓扑
底部的火焰形态及其托举音符的空间关系
代表‘火山’属性的暖色调倾向（映射为红/黄）
recompose_allowed: 火焰的具体边缘形状（简化为圆润的几何色块或波浪形）
音符内部的渐变高光（替换为纯色填充或简单的装饰性元素如星星）
颜色的具体色值（强制映射为主题限定的砖红、深蓝、奶黄/米白）
线条的平滑度（转化为带有抖动感的徒手线条）
restyle: 将原本平滑的白色音符转化为奶黄色/米白色块
将写实的橙红火焰简化为红黄相间的几何色块堆叠
添加不规则、粗细不均的黑色马克笔风格描边
模拟蜡笔或粉笔在粗糙表面的哑光质感
decorate: 可在音符头部内部嵌入简单的主题装饰元素（如蓝色四角星）以增强趣味性
保持构图松散自由，不追求严格对称
forbid: 保留原本的白色渐变、立体光泽或3D渲染效果
使用橙色、紫色、绿色等主题色板之外的颜色
火焰形状过于写实、尖锐或复杂
描边过细、边缘过于平滑锐利或缺失描边
背景非纯黑或包含额外装饰性光效/纹理
将音符替换为通用音乐符号或其他App标识
generation_brief: Retro hand-drawn doodle style icon on pure black background. Central subject is a simplified musical note (creamy yellow fill) resting on top of geometric flames (brick red and orange-yellow fills). Heavy, irregular, clumsy black marker outlines around all shapes. Flat colors, no gradients, no shadows, no lighting effects. Naive art aesthetic, high contrast, crayon texture.
color_application: Map original white note to creamy yellow/off-white; map original orange/red gradient flame to distinct blocks of brick red and warm yellow. Strictly adhere to the limited palette: Black background, Brick Red, Deep Blue (if used for accents), Creamy Yellow. No gradients allowed.
stroke_application: Apply thick, irregular, hand-drawn black outlines to both the note and the flame shapes. Edges should appear rough and shaky, simulating a marker or crayon stroke, avoiding clean vector lines.
composition_application: Center the combined 'note-on-flame' structure. Ensure it occupies 50-70% of the canvas. Maintain the vertical stacking (note above flame) but simplify the internal details to geometric blocks. Keep ample black space around the subject.
identity_application: Preserve the specific topology of the Douyin note (circle bottom, flag top) and the upward-pointing flame shape below it. The combination must remain instantly recognizable as Douyin Huoshan, despite the stylistic simplification and color shift.
fidelity_constraints: Must have thick, irregular hand-drawn black strokes
Colors must be flat, high-saturation primary/secondary tones from the theme palette (Red, Blue, Yellow/White)
No gradients, shadows, highlights, or 3D effects
Subject must look like a naive, hand-drawn doodle
negative_constraints: No realistic textures, photos, or 3D renders
No smooth vector lines or perfect symmetry
No colors outside the theme palette (e.g., green, purple, neon)
No white background or complex scenic backgrounds
Do not change the core shape of the note or remove the flame element
